name: news
description: Read the daily news digest FRED builds at 6 am and 6 pm: AI news from around the world, major Indian news, CBSE and NCERT board news, world events and one general story. Gives a short two-line summary of each story with its source, or the full detailed paragraph of one story when a number is given. Use it for any question about the news, headlines, what happened today, or more detail on a story from the digest.

topic.description: which part of the digest: ai, india, boards (CBSE/NCERT), world, general; all for everything

number.description: the story number from the list to read in full; leave out (or 0) for the short list

detail.description: true to get the full paragraphs of the stories in the chosen topic (when the user wants more on a part of the news without naming a number)

edition.description: latest = the newest digest; earlier = the earlier unread digest of the day (the morning one) after the user says yes to hearing it too

examples: what's the news
read me the news
any AI news today
what's happening in India
any CBSE news
tell me more about number three
what's going on in the world
give me the headlines
more on the second story
what happened in AI today
yes read the morning one too
what was in the morning news
read the earlier news as well
get more on the boards news
dig deeper into the CBSE board dates story
tell me more about the India news
more detail on the AI story
get more on the boards dates
get more on that story you just read
is the timetable in the boards news too
not_for: searching the web for a specific topic (use web_search)
